message.content:
The title of “best player” in soccer is always debated and depends on the criteria you use—goals, assists, influence on the game, trophies, or individual awards. As of mid‑2024, the most frequently cited names are:

| Player | Nationality | Club (2024) | Key Strengths |
|--------|-------------|-------------|---------------|
| **Lionel Messi** | Argentina | Inter Miami (MLS) | Vision, dribbling, play‑making, longevity |
| **Kylian Mbappé** | France | Paris Saint‑Germain | Pace, finishing, versatility |
| **Erling Haaland** | Norway | Manchester City | Physicality, positioning, goal‑scoring consistency |
| **Kevin De Bruyne** | Belgium | Manchester City | Passing range, tactical awareness, set‑piece mastery |
| **Karim Benzema** | France | Real Madrid | Link‑up play, work rate, experience |

If you’re looking at recent form and impact on the 2024 season, **Erling Haaland** has been a standout with an exceptional goal‑scoring record for Manchester City, while **Kylian Mbappé** continues to be a top performer for PSG and the French national team.

Ultimately, the “best” player can vary depending on whether you value individual brilliance, team success, or a combination of both.
